sub_graphs.title: BLAKE2F Precompile: Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the strict input validation requirements for the BLAKE2F precompiled contract

nodes.label: BLAKE2F Precompile Call Received
nodes.description: A CALL to address 0x09 has been received with input data

nodes.label: Check Input Length is 213 Bytes
nodes.description: Verify that input data is exactly 213 bytes, no more, no less

nodes.label: Input Length Valid (213 bytes)
nodes.description: Input data is exactly 213 bytes as required

nodes.label: Input Length Invalid
nodes.description: Input data length is not exactly 213 bytes

nodes.label: Raise InvalidParameter (Length)
nodes.description: Raise InvalidParameter exception due to wrong input length

nodes.label: Parse BLAKE2 Parameters
nodes.description: Extract rounds, h, m, t_0, t_1, and f from the 213-byte input

nodes.label: Check Final Block Flag Value
nodes.description: Verify that the final flag (f) is either 0 or 1

nodes.label: Final Flag Valid (0 or 1)
nodes.description: Final block flag is a valid binary value

nodes.label: Final Flag Invalid (not 0 or 1)
nodes.description: Final block flag has an invalid value

nodes.label: Raise InvalidParameter (Flag)
nodes.description: Raise InvalidParameter exception due to invalid final flag

nodes.label: All Validation Passed
nodes.description: Input is valid and ready for compression computation

nodes.label: Precompile Call Failed
nodes.description: BLAKE2F precompile failed due to invalid parameters

external_entities.name: Contract Calling BLAKE2F
external_entities.description: Smart contract or EOA that invoked the BLAKE2F precompile via CALL

sub_graphs.title: BLAKE2F Precompile: Gas Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the dynamic gas charging mechanism based on number of compression rounds

nodes.label: Compression Rounds Extracted
nodes.description: The number of rounds has been parsed from the first 4 bytes of input

nodes.label: Compute Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate total gas as GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND * rounds

nodes.label: Charge Computed Gas
nodes.description: Deduct the computed gas cost from available gas

nodes.label: Sufficient Gas Available
nodes.description: Available gas is >= required gas cost

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas - Out of Gas
nodes.description: Available gas is less than required, causing out-of-gas error

nodes.label: Raise OutOfGas Exception
nodes.description: Raise out-of-gas exception, reverting the call

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Charged
nodes.description: Gas has been deducted, ready for compression computation

nodes.label: Call Reverted - Out of Gas
nodes.description: Precompile call has reverted due to insufficient gas

sub_graphs.title: BLAKE2F Precompile: Compression Function Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the BLAKE2b compression function execution and output generation

nodes.label: Ready for Compression
nodes.description: Inputs validated and gas charged, ready to execute BLAKE2b compression

nodes.label: Initialize BLAKE2b State
nodes.description: Set up the BLAKE2b state with provided h (hash state) values

nodes.label: Execute Compression Rounds
nodes.description: Perform the specified number of mixing rounds on the state using message block m

nodes.label: Apply Offset Counter (t)
nodes.description: Apply the 128-bit offset counter (t_0, t_1) to the state

nodes.label: Apply Final Block Flag
nodes.description: If f=1, apply final block processing to the state

nodes.label: Extract 64-byte Output
nodes.description: Extract the 64-byte output from the final hash state

nodes.label: Set EVM Output
nodes.description: Set evm.output to the 64-byte compression result

nodes.label: Compression Complete
nodes.description: BLAKE2F compression function has completed successfully

ambiguities.text: The precompile address (0x09) is not explicitly stated in the module documentation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume address 0x09 based on EIP-152 specification. This should be verified against the precompile mapping module.

ambiguities.text: The exact numeric value of GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND is referenced but not defined in this module
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND = 1 as per EIP-152. Verify against gas constants module.

ambiguities.text: The format of the 213-byte input is described by parameter names but not explicit byte offsets
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-152 format: bytes 0-3 = rounds (big-endian), bytes 4-67 = h (8x8 bytes), bytes 68-195 = m (16x8 bytes), bytes 196-203 = t_0, bytes 204-211 = t_1, byte 212 = f.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Blake2b.compress implementation correctly implements the BLAKE2b compression function per RFC 7693
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect hash outputs could break cryptographic verification schemes relying on BLAKE2, enabling forgery attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot cause the compression function to enter an infinite loop or use resources beyond O(rounds)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Denial of service through resource exhaustion if rounds is very large and gas is miscalculated

implicit_assumptions.description: The per-round gas cost accurately reflects actual computational cost of BLAKE2 mixing rounds
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced gas could enable DoS by requesting maximum rounds, or overpriced gas could make legitimate use uneconomical
